_comment: The X2's images for gen-inhibit's bench chain, pinned as a tool of its harness (gen-inhibit reviewer's tracker row 'The X2's image is a pinned tool of gen-inhibit's harness', user ruling 2026-11-10). x2_pin.py reads it. The files are not in git: each sits at <x2_pin_dir>/<pin>/<image>/<name>, x2_pin_dir from the local settings, and must have the size, sha256 and md5 given here. No setting can change an image's files or identity. A re-pin is a new pin here, with its premises checked against the new image.

source.manifest: charge-interposer/firmware/builds/manifest.json at 2bf01df: the rows for env esp32-can-x2 and env slcan, src_digest 36edf3e55552, git_dirty false
source.built: PlatformIO, all six environments, in a detached worktree at 4a59647, by the charge-interposer tester on 2026-11-02 (reverse-it artifacts/interposer-firmware/images/README.md); each app's md5 and ELF sha256 equal its manifest row
source.boot_app0: boot_app0.bin is the PlatformIO Arduino framework's tools/partitions/boot_app0.bin, which the interposer's builds flash at 0xe000

x2_app.identity_read: 0x7F7 intp_build_id, read by the interposer's bench_identify from an ACKed boot: the app ELF sha256's first 8 hex digits

x2_slcan.identity_read: the SLCAN answers to V and N, which name the protocol, not the build; the suite takes the identity only when esptool verify-flash finds this app at its offset
